foil.title: Energy repricing risk from Red Sea maritime disruption state
foil.scenario_short: Red Sea maritime disruption will sustain energy repricing pressure near 72% over 30 days, driven by 7 urgent critical signals reinforcing energy supply shock, with 69% pressure and 76% state confirmation from the...
foil.perspective_strategic: The 69% probability with 76% state confirmation indicates a stable but elevated energy repricing risk, with the strongest transmission path running through energy supply shock across 1 edge toward Energy, signaling sustained market pressure.
foil.perspective_contrarian: Headlines showing oil prices in freefall and hope for an end to the Iran war could reverse the path if diplomatic breakthroughs reduce the perceived risk of Red Sea disruption, undermining the current 69% baseline.
foil.actor_lens: Commodity traders: Price whether stress in Red Sea becomes durable over the 30d. Rebalance positions if the probability path moves away from 69%.
foil.top_signal: Red Sea maritime disruption state is feeding energy repricing through energy supply shock, with 69% pressure and 76% state confirmation

seismic-infrastructure.absence_reason: No product publishes a seismic forecast — earthquakes are not predictable, so there is no forecast/intel alternative to azimuth's observed USGS record. This is the honest inverse: for an observed natural-hazard fact, the sourced record IS the only trustworthy source.
